create_smollm3_config: create a SmolLM3Config instance with custom vocab size, hidden size, and number of layers
initialize_smollm3_model: initialize a SmolLM3Model from a SmolLM3Config and access its configuration
configure_rope_layers: configure SmolLM3Config with custom no_rope_layers or no_rope_layer_interval for RoPE layer selection
inspect_smollm3_attention: inspect SmolLM3Config attention parameters including num_attention_heads, num_key_value_heads, and attention_dropout
review_smollm3_config: review the SmolLM3Config class and its default model parameters for the HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B checkpoint
